standard.summary: FLUX 模型由多个组件组成：Transformer（主模型）、AE（autoencoder）、T5-XXL（大语言模型编码器）、CLIP-L（视觉语言编码器）。每个组件需要单独指定路径。
standard.effect: ae_path 指定 autoencoder；t5xxl_path 指定 T5 文本编码器；clip_l_path 指定 CLIP-L。t5_max_token_length 控制 T5 的最大 token 数（默认 512）。
standard.whenToUse: FLUX LoRA 训练时必须指定这些路径。可以使用本地路径或 HuggingFace repo ID。
standard.avoidWhen: FLUX.1-dev 的 T5-XXL 约 10GB，确保磁盘空间足够。t5_max_token_length 不要设太大（T5 推理开销随 token 数平方增长）。

standard_en.summary: A FLUX model is made of several components: the transformer (the main model), the AE (autoencoder), T5-XXL (a large language model encoder) and CLIP-L (a vision-language encoder). Each needs its own path.
standard_en.effect: ae_path names the autoencoder; t5xxl_path the T5 text encoder; clip_l_path CLIP-L. t5_max_token_length caps T5's token count (512 by default).
standard_en.whenToUse: These paths are required for FLUX LoRA training. A local path or a HuggingFace repo ID both work.
standard_en.avoidWhen: FLUX.1-dev's T5-XXL is around 10GB, so make sure you have the disk space. Do not set t5_max_token_length too high -- T5's inference cost grows with the square of the token count.

advanced.principle: FLUX 使用三重文本编码：CLIP-L 编码短 prompt（77 token），T5-XXL 编码长 prompt（512 token），两者拼接后传入 Transformer。AE 负责图像↔latent 转换。flux_transformer_path 可以单独指定 Transformer 权重（与底模路径分开）。flux_transformer_offload 控制 Transformer 的 CPU offload 策略。
advanced.intervention: trainer.py 加载各组件并构建 FLUX pipeline。
advanced.expectedImpact: 路径配置不影响训练质量，但缺失或错误的路径会导致训练失败。
advanced.tradeoffs: flux_requested_network_module 控制 FLUX 使用哪种 LoRA 模块格式。
advanced.codePath: trainer.py:FLUX pipeline → load AE + T5-XXL + CLIP-L + Transformer

advanced_en.principle: FLUX uses triple text encoding: CLIP-L encodes the short prompt (77 tokens), T5-XXL the long prompt (512 tokens), both concatenated and fed to the Transformer. The AE handles image↔latent conversion. flux_transformer_path can specify Transformer weights separately from the base model path. flux_transformer_offload controls the Transformer's CPU offload policy.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer.py loads the components and builds the FLUX pipeline.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Path configuration does not affect training quality, but missing or wrong paths fail training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: flux_requested_network_module controls which LoRA module format FLUX uses.
advanced_en.codePath: trainer.py:FLUX pipeline → load AE + T5-XXL + CLIP-L + Transformer
